title: Counting large cliques in graphs with a forbidden tree
summary: Given graphs $H$ and $F$, the generalized Turán number ${\rm ex}(n,H,F)$ is the maximum number of copies of $H$ in an $n$-vertex $F$-free graph. Alon and Shikhelman (J. Combin. Theory Ser. B, 2016) initiated the systematic study of generalized Turán problems. Let $T$ be a tree on $k$ vertices, and write $n=a(k-1)+b$, where $0\leq b<k-1$. Recently, Gerbner and Palmer (Electron. J. Combin., 2026) proposed the following conjecture: for every $r\geq3$, the graph $aK_{k-1}\cup K_b$ maximizes the number of copies of $K_r$ among all $n$-vertex $T$-free graphs.
